correctness.rationale: For T=I+N the displayed binary operation is exact. Closure forces, and is forced by, independent W-coset unions in all fibers, with W the additive prime-field span of base-support differences. Finite translations are invertible on any preserved finite fiber. Each B has a unique affine span. Affine-lattice Möbius inversion gives a_{t,j}, counting fixed-flat j-element subsets. There are p^(f-t)*[f choose t]_p ambient affine flats and each selected fiber contributes (1+z^(p^t))^(p^(f-t))-1; multiplying and summing yields the claimed polynomial. Exhaustive native operation checks of 4-, 9-, and 16-point quandles agree; further coefficient identities checked. All characteristic and boundary cases p>=2, f>=1 handled. The checker is not the general proof.

value.rationale: Complete embedded-subquandle size distributions are natural invariants of finite quandles and their substructure lattices. This infinite family is the simplest genuine nonsemisimple Alexander family; it is disconnected and admits arbitrary base supports, so connected-component enumerations miss almost all the substructure. A uniform formula and bijection expose the prime-field vs extension-field behavior and solve all cardinalities, not a tiny isolated finite count.
